set.body:
Zero uses anywhere in tests/, vignettes/, README, bench/, scripts/ - the strings
do not occur outside R/:

  nuisance_projection      0 sites
  parallel_voxels          0 sites
  volume_weights_options   0 sites on fmri_lm() (4 on fmri_lm_control())
  soft_subspace_options    0 sites on fmri_lm() (5 on fmri_lm_control())

Near-vestigial, decide separately: volume_weights has 4 sites
(test-lowrank-engine-contract.R:25,122 and test-plugin-api.R:243) and every one
asserts an engine REJECTS it - it is never used for a successful fit.

With no callers these can go straight to deprecate_stop() or removal.
set.title: Delete four formals with zero call sites
